messages:
marta: FYI — audit alerted: service-account `data-worker-sa` got an ephemeral role binding `cluster-admin-lite` via the new ephemerals flow. Observed object reads from `s3://redwood-analytics` in the last hour. I think this came from yesterday's RBAC refactor deploy. Can we triage?

devin: Oof. Can you paste the alert? Need logs + which job used that SA.

sre-bot: [security-alert] 1967654321 — ephemeral-binding detected for `data-worker-sa` -> `cluster-admin-lite`. Objects read: analytics/*, last 37m. Audit logs stored at gs://redwood-audit/2026/03/20/1967654.log

marta: Attached snippet: `2026-03-20T14:12:02Z user=system:serviceaccount:data:data-worker-sa action=getObject bucket=redwood-analytics key=events/2026-03-20/part-0003`

raj: Likely path: change landed in infra repo PR #3345 that introduced the ephemeral allowlist logic. If someone forgot to restrict `targetNamespaces`, ephemeral bindings default to cluster-level role.

anya: Immediate mitigation: revoke current ephemeral tokens and patch the ephemeral controller config to disallow cluster roles for that SA. I can revoke tokens now if someone approves.

chris: +1 approve. Also rollback the change on the infra side so no new bindings are created. I can push rollback once we confirm scope.

devin: Steps I recommend: 1) Revoke tokens for `data-worker-sa` (anya) 2) Patch ephemeral controller to reject cluster roles (marta + chris) 3) Rollback PR #3345 to staging then prod (chris) 4) Audit search for any other service accounts with ephemeral cluster role bindings (devin) 5) Consider KMS key access review for analytics bucket (raj)

anya: Revoking token now: `kubectl delete secret -n data $(kubectl get sa data-worker-sa -n data -o jsonpath="{.secrets[0].name}")` — done. Confirmed no active pods using the token (checked with `ps` on nodes). :white_check_mark:

marta: Thanks. Patch applied to ephemeral controller to disallow cluster roles for ephemeral grants. Config diff: ```- allow_cluster_roles: true
+ allow_cluster_roles: false```

devin: Doing wide audit: running `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="google.storage.objects.get" AND resource.labels.bucket_name="redwood-analytics" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:service-account' --limit 10000 --format json'`. Will report back with list.

raj: On KMS: analytics objects are encrypted with `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/analytics/cryptoKeys/analytics-kms-key`. If the SA had GetCryptoKeyVersion permissions, they could decrypt object-level CEK if envelope keys used. Need to check IAM on that key.

chris: I'll rollback PR #3345 to stop new ephemerals. Pushing now to staging then prod after smoke. ETA 20m.

marta: We should also: a) rotate any exposed short-lived creds? b) enable finer-grained audit export (object level) for analytics for 30d c) add alert if ephemeral controller ever assigns cluster role again.

anya: On rotation: these were ephemeral tokens, not long-lived AWS keys. But to be safe ops team will rotate the analytics KMS key if we find binding had decrypt privileges. I can coordinate with cloud-sec.

devin: Audit results: found 3 other SAs temporarily bound to cluster-level role in last 24h — all from same infra PR. Marking them for manual review. Uploading results to /tmp/1967654321-audit-results.json and https://redwood.s3/incident/1967654321/report.json

marta: Good catch. Actions assigned: anya — confirm KMS IAM on `analytics-kms-key` and request rotation if needed; devin — full audit results and list of affected objects; chris — infra rollback and create safe defaults; raj — postmortem skeleton. We'll reconvene in 30m. Reactions: :rotating_light: :lock: :hammer:

sre-bot: Incident ticket created: SEC-2026-042. Pager duty notified.

chris: Rollback pushed to staging and prod, smoke passed. No new ephemeral bindings after patch.

anya: Checked KMS IAM: `data-worker-sa` did NOT have cryptoKeyDecrypt on analytics key. No evidence of decrypt or write. Still recommending key rotation window = 72h as precaution.

devin: Audit CSV attached to incident. Affected objects reads count: 127 objects, all read-only. No writes, no list of entire bucket.

marta: Closing immediate containment. Postmortem assigned to raj, include timeline + remediation: reject cluster roles by default, add CI check to block PRs that bump ephemeral allowlists, add unit test + alerting.

raj: I'll start the postmortem doc now. ETA for write-up: EOD.

marta: Thanks everyone. Filing follow-up tasks in SEC-2026-042.
